title: Billing Specialist
jobDescription:
Job Description View All Jobs View Our Website We know that finding a meaningful and rewarding job can be a long journey. Our goal is to make that process as easy as possible for you. Start your journey with us by browsing available jobs. At Workplace Options, we are committed to and are accountable for building a workplace where individuals feel empowered to bring their whole selves to work, free from judgment or fear of discrimination. We understand that having a diverse organization is only the beginning and it will require nurturing and care to thrive. We will continue to take action to ensure we achieve equitable and measurable outcomes. We strive to cultivate a space where diverse voices are not only heard but actively sought out and valued for the unique insights they bring. By embracing and promoting authenticity, we aim to build a vibrant and inclusive community that fosters collaboration, innovation, belonging and personal growth. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- Nous savons que la recherche d'un emploi intéressant et gratifiant peut être un long parcours. Notre objectif est de rendre ce processus aussi facile que possible pour vous. Commencez votre parcours avec nous en consultant les offres d'emploi disponibles. Chez Workplace Options, nous nous engageons à construire un lieu de travail où les individus se sentent habilités à apporter leur entièreté au travail, sans jugement ni crainte de discrimination, et nous en sommes responsables. Nous comprenons qu'une organisation diversifiée n'est qu'un début et qu'elle aura besoin de soins et d'attention pour s'épanouir. Nous continuerons à prendre des mesures pour obtenir des résultats équitables et mesurables. Nous nous efforçons de cultiver un espace où les différentes voix sont non seulement entendues, mais aussi activement recherchées et appréciées pour les perspectives uniques qu'elles apportent. En embrassant et en promouvant l'authenticité, nous visons à construire une communauté dynamique et inclusive qui favorise la collaboration, l'innovation, l'appartenance et l'épanouissement personnel. Billing Specialist Bangalore, Karnataka, India Full Time Entry Level Share At Workplace Options (WPO), we deliver human-centric solutions that empower people to thrive personally and professionally. With a global team of more than 4,800 professionals, we provide real-time emotional support, therapy, coaching, mindfulness, and family services to millions worldwide. Since 1982, we’ve partnered with employers, health plans, and insurers to design flexible, forward-thinking programs that evolve alongside today’s changing workforce.    Today, we support 160 million people across 150,000 organizations, including over half of Fortune 500 companies. Now part of the TELUS Health family, we are expanding our global impact by combining decades of wellbeing expertise. Together, we’re building healthier, more resilient organizations—one person at a time.  Current opportunity: Billing Specialist Location: Bangalore Shifts: Monday
- Friday 7pm-4am Hybrid/Remote: This will be a hybrid position Salary: 5.5 lacs per annum plus night shift allowance What you will do: The Billing Specialist assists the Workplace Options Provider Relations Department by receiving, logging, and processing provider invoices for payment.  This position reports to the Billing Team Lead. Job

RESPONSIBILITIES:
  Receive, log, review and process provider invoices for payment. Identify provider needs and be able to respond to and resolve payment inquiries. Communicate/respond to providers in a professional manner regarding their payment status. Match the appropriate invoice with a client’s case using our proprietary case management system. Enter provider information into our database/case management system. Maintain strict confidentiality of our clients’ information, proactively manage workload. Any additional tasks pertinent to the position, as deemed appropriate by management. Qualifications/Skills:  Any bachelor’s degree.  Excellent interpersonal, written, and oral communication skills. Ability to work effectively as a team member in a team environment. Comfortable in a fast-paced work environment. Ability to multitask while maintaining a high level of quality and productivity. Ability to navigate proficiently in varying databases and on the internet. What we offer: At Workplace Options, we don’t just deliver wellbeing services to our clients, we champion wellbeing for our own employees as well. Examples of our benefits and commitment to employee wellbeing include: Benefits
- Group Mediclaim Insurance for 6 lacs INR, Accident Insurance, Gym reimbursement, Tuition reimbursement, EAP Support Services, Mentorship program, WPO Cares, Employee exchange program, Comprehensive training provided for this position. At Workplace Options, we are committed to and are accountable for building a workplace where individuals feel empowered to bring their whole selves to work, free from judgment or fear of discrimination. We understand that having a diverse organization is only the beginning and it will require nurturing and care to thrive. We will continue to take action to ensure we achieve equitable and measurable outcomes. We strive to cultivate a space where diverse voices are not only heard but actively sought out and valued for the unique insights they bring. By embracing and promoting authenticity, we aim to build a vibrant and inclusive community that fosters collaboration, innovation, belonging and personal growth. For further details about WPO please check out our website www.workplaceoptions.com and these short videos give a great overview of what we do Human-Powered Care  and  The WPO Global Experience   Workplace Options collects and processes personal data in accordance with applicable data protection laws. If you are a European job applicant, refer to our Privacy Notice for further details (https://www.workplaceoptions.com/privacy-notice-for-recruitment/). Tech Lead
- Integration Bangalore, Karnataka, India Full Time IT Mid Level Share Workplace Options: At Workplace Options (WPO), we deliver human-centric solutions that empower people to thrive
- personally and professionally. With a global team of more than 4,800 professionals, we provide real-time emotional support, therapy, coaching, mindfulness, and family services to millions worldwide. Since 1982, we’ve partnered with employers, health plans, and insurers to design flexible, forward-thinking programs that evolve alongside today’s changing workforce. Today, we support 160 million people across 150,000 organizations, including over half of Fortune 500 companies. Now part of the TELUS Health family, we are expanding our global impact by combining decades of wellbeing expertise. Together, we’re building healthier, more resilient organizations—one person at a time. WPO is looking forward to take their technology investments to next generation with cutting-edge integration platforms based on Cloud technologies. Selected candidates will have opportunity to work with a great technology team, diverse across globe. Job Description: Integration Lead Workplace Options (WPO) requires a Technical Integration Lead to help connect disparate systems using a middleware cloud platform. The Technical Integration Lead will work as part of the development team.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Develop and implement software integrations using middleware and cloud platforms. Collaborate with architects and teams to deliver reliable API-driven solutions, focusing on security, data flows, and connectivity. Implement integrations following established architecture principles for middleware and IPaa S platforms. Build and support API Gateways and cloud integration flows under guidance. Integrate with data storages and databases for seamless application connectivity. Apply application security best practices for software, messaging, and infrastructure. Implement SSO using Okta, Azure AD, or Auth O in integration solutions. Work with cloud networking elements like Express Route, Firewalls, and APIM. Participate in development using coding skills and contribute to JIRA-tracked tasks. Any additional tasks pertinent to the position, as deemed appropriate by management. Qualifications/Skills: 7+ years of experience in software integrations (architecture, development, or consulting). Experience with Enterprise Middleware Platforms or Cloud Integration Platforms including IPaa S. Good understanding of application architectures, data storages, and databases; proficient in application development/coding. Experience with Cloud technologies, especially API Gateways. Hands-on experience with application security (software, messaging, infrastructure related to integrations). Familiarity with Microsoft Azure Cloud platform and services (Azure Service Bus, Azure Integration Services, Azure API Gateways, Azure Key Vault, Azure App Service). Exposure to Atlassian JIRA and Confluence. Experience with Single Sign-on technologies (Okta, Azure AD, Auth O). Working knowledge of cloud Networking technologies (Express Route, Firewalls, APIM) Demonstrate courteousness and respect to people across diverse cultures, age groups and varied business groups What we offer: At Workplace Options, we don’t just deliver wellbeing services to our clients, we champion wellbeing for our own employees as well. Examples of our benefits and commitment to employee wellbeing include: Benefits
- Group Mediclaim Insurance for 6 lacs INR, Accident Insurance, Gym reimbursement, Tuition reimbursement, EAP Support Services, Mentorship program, WPO Cares, Employee exchange program, Comprehensive training provided for this position At Workplace Options, we are committed to and are accountable for building a workplace where individuals feel empowered to bring their whole selves to work, free from judgment or fear of discrimination. We understand that having a diverse organization is only the beginning and it will require nurturing and care to thrive. We will continue to take action to ensure we achieve equitable and measurable outcomes. We strive to cultivate a space where diverse voices are not only heard but actively sought out and valued for the unique insights they bring. By embracing and promoting authenticity, we aim to build a vibrant and inclusive community that fosters collaboration, innovation, belonging and personal growth. For further details about WPO please check out our website www.workplaceoptions.com and these short videos give a great overview of what we do Human-Powered Care  and  The WPO Global Experience   Workplace Options collects and processes personal data in accordance with applicable data protection laws. If you are a European job applicant, refer to our Privacy Notice for further details (https://www.workplaceoptions.com/privacy-notice-for-recruitment/).
